dct_title_s: Damage Assessment in Gyan district, Pakteka province as of 24 June 2022
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: EQ20220622AFG** This map illustrates potentially damaged buildings and damaged buildings in Gyan district, Pakteka province of Afghanistan as detected by Jilin-1 satellite image acquired on 24 June 2022. Within the analyzed area, UNOSAT has identified 39 potentially damaged buildings, 22 damaged buildings and 33 shelters. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
